title: The Lookout, Gort Road, Loughrea, Co. Galway, H62TN50
seoTitle: The Lookout, Gort Road, Loughrea, Co. Galway, H62TN50
description:
Exceptional new build architect-designed lakeside residence with panoramic views over Lough Rea, finished to an outstanding specification throughout.

Occupying an exceptional lakeside setting on the shores of Lough Rea, The Lookout is a striking contemporary residence designed to maximise its enviable position and panoramic views across the lake, with the Slieve Aughty Mountains providing a spectacular backdrop.

Approached via a professionally landscaped tarmacadam driveway bordered by square-profile kerbing and mature planting, the quality of craftsmanship and attention to detail is immediately evident. Internally, the accommodation has been thoughtfully designed to create a bright, modern living environment, finished to a notably high specification throughout.

A welcoming entrance porch leads to the ground floor accommodation, where a light-filled hallway provides access to three generous double bedrooms, all featuring bespoke fitted wardrobes. The principal bedroom benefits from a luxurious en suite and elegant feature panelling, while the other two bedrooms enjoy direct access to the rear garden. A spacious family bathroom, cloakroom and fully fitted utility room complete the accommodation at ground floor level. Porcelain floor tiling extends throughout the circulation areas and bathrooms, complemented by quality timber flooring within the bedrooms.

At first-floor level, the dramatic open-plan kitchen/dining/ living area forms the heart of the home. Positioned to capture uninterrupted views over Lough Rea, the impressive space enjoys an abundance of natural light and seamless connectivity to both indoor and outdoor living areas.
A bespoke kitchen has been finished to an exceptional standard, featuring quartz worktops with waterfall-edge detailing, an expansive central island, an under-mounted 1.5 bowl sink with fluted drainer, an oversized hob and cleverly concealed breakfast bar with appliance storage area. A guest WC and additional storage completes this first floor level.

A standout feature is the glazed balcony extending from the main living space, offering a stunning vantage point from which to enjoy the panoramic lake views. Direct access is also provided to the private rear garden via a contemporary external staircase.

The rear garden is laid out principally in lawn and complemented by an attractive paved patio area, creating an ideal setting for outdoor dining and entertaining. External lighting to both the front and rear further enhances the property's appeal.

Thoughtful architectural detailing is evident including striking glazed floor features at first-floor level that allows natural light to permeate the hall below, together with a bespoke internal picture window above the staircase that perfectly frames the surrounding landscape.

The Lookout benefits from an impressive A-rated specification, including air-to-water heat pump system, underfloor heating throughout, mechanical heat recovery ventilation, high levels of insulation and airtightness, and triple-glazed PVC windows and French doors. A composite front door with hardwood frame further enhances thermal performance and security. Electrical specifications include ducting for fibre broadband, USB charging points and a comprehensive range of modern conveniences, ensuring the property is as efficient and future-proofed as it is visually impressive.

Combining contemporary architecture, exceptional energy efficiency and an unrivalled lakeside setting, The Lookout represents a rare opportunity to acquire a truly distinctive home in one of East Galway's most desirable locations.

Set on the shores of the picturesque Lough Rea, approximately 30 km southeast of Galway City, Loughrea is a thriving market town rich in history and character. Translating as the "town of the grey lake", Loughrea retains much of its medieval heritage, with remnants of its Anglo-Norman past still evident today, including sections of the original town wall and gate.

Centred around the lake from which it takes its name, Loughrea offers an exceptional quality of life with scenic lakeside walks, swimming, fishing and a wealth of outdoor pursuits. The town serves as a key commercial hub for East Galway and is a popular residential location for those commuting to Galway City, benefiting from an excellent range of schools, sporting facilities, cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities, all within a welcoming community atmosphere.

For outdoor enthusiasts, the Slieve Aughty Mountains lie just 12 km away, offering extensive walking and cycling trails together with a number of renowned equestrian centres. Coole Park Nature Reserve is located approximately 25 km from the property, while Portumna Forest Park, with its castle, marina and lakeside walking routes, is within 30 km. The renowned Lough Derg, Ireland's third-largest lake, is also approximately 30 km away and provides extensive sailing and watersports facilities.

Ideally positioned between Galway City, The Burren, Lough Derg and the heritage towns of East Galway, Loughrea provides an excellent base from which to explore Galway and the wider west of Ireland.

Connectivity is excellent, with convenient access to the M6 motorway linking Galway City and Dublin via the M4. Shannon Airport is approximately 70 km away, Ireland West Airport Knock is 100 km distant, while Dublin Airport can be reached within approximately 180 km.
